Om. By the sign of the Chitraratha, the Kshatriya status of Paurayana is established, as is the case in the subsequent section. Om. 1/3/35.

The phrase “This is the Ashvatari chariot” serves as a sign indicating its association with the Chitraratha, thereby establishing Paurayana’s Kshatriya status. In the Brahma (Sutra), it is stated: “The chariot, being equipped with the Ashvatari, is called Chitra.” In the Brahma Vaivarta (Purana), it is said: “Where there is the Veda, there is the chariot; where there is no chariot, there is no Veda.”
